name: xyz.cohostbnb/cohostbnb
title: CoHostBnB
description: Short-term-rental co-hosting: public state rules, guide, plans and pricing. Read-only.

tools.name: check_state_availability
tools.description:
Return the exact public state-rules response: GREEN/YELLOW/RED/UNKNOWN,
        managed_allowed, verification, missing requirements, fees and disclosures.
        State verification is required before ordering; this lookup cannot verify it.

tools.name: get_public_guide
tools.description: Read /v1/public-api/guide verbatim; does not grant tenant API access.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: What CoHostBnB sells, who runs it, and every agent entry point (llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP).

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Every plan with its USD price and buy link; identical to https://cohostbnb.xyz/pricing.json.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find CoHostBnB pages by keyword; returns url, title and description.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description:
Return a public buy link for Host or Autopilot, or the required application link for a managed plan.
        A human opens the link to start checkout.
